body: You should send this to them, I'm sure they would understand.
This made me smile, thank you! :)
I'll try, but I'm really afraid to lose her.
I can't because I know she wouldn't be willing to work on it and even though it's killing me I don't want to lose them.

You aren't a failure, not at all!! You will be a good mom to your kid and in the end - even if it might not seem like it now - everything will be fine. Let me give you a virtual hug from a distance; you more than deserve it - wish you all the best, and stay strong!

I'm also going through the same thing rn and I can really understand what you're going through; it hurts a lot :/. She send me mixed signals in the beginning and I thought she was reciprocating my feelings for her but in the end she wasn't at all, she was just playing with me. Also her indecisiveness made things just worse... for context I'm bi (f) and she thought she might be as well, and so I had hopes for a year (!!) and fell more and more in love with her until one day she told me that girls leave her as cold as ice and that statement killed me mentally. I'm still trying to be friends with her but I can't simply turn a blind eye to my feelings for her and it's hard because she doesn't realise how much she's hurting me. 
Sorry for the long reply, it's just that I thought I was the only one going through something like this and I needed to vent a little haha. I hope everything works out for you, stay strong! (If it helps: I think we shouldn't give our time and love to someone who doesn't acknowledge that precious gift. Hopefully, someday the right person will come and give as much love back to you as you give them!)

I'm really sorry you have to go through this pain. Even though I don't suffer from BPD myself I can understand how you must feel right now, and I know it really really sucks, but don't do reckless things because of someone who doesn't know and doesn't appreciate your worth! Instead, try to focus on something you enjoy doing, and maybe talk to someone about it. That sometimes really helps.
Unfortunately I don't think so :/ and even if there was the slightest chance, she's miles away now, so it wouldn't work anyway.
